vendorPanelUser.title: VendorPanel email
vendorPanelUser.description: Login email for the supplier account. Leave blank to run in discovery-only mode.

googleServiceAccount.title: Google service account JSON
googleServiceAccount.description: Paste the whole service-account key JSON. Share the spreadsheet and Drive folder with this account's email as Editor.

driveFolderId.title: Drive folder ID
driveFolderId.description: Folder that downloaded packs are uploaded into. Put it in the same Google account as the Workflow 2 Drive credential.

maxTenders.title: Max tenders per run
maxTenders.description: Safety cap so a misconfigured run cannot hammer the portal.

dryRun.title: Dry run
dryRun.description: Log what would happen without uploading files or writing to the sheet.
